international_aviation.headline: 通用動力Q2營收140.9億美元 航太部門成長領先
international_aviation.summary: 根據通用動力於2026年7月29日發布的第二季財報，公司整體營收達到140.9億美元，其中航太部門的增長速度在各業務條線中最快。這也意味著航太業務成為集團當季增長的主要引擎。
international_aviation.headline_en: General Dynamics Q2 revenue $14.09B; Aerospace segment leads growth
international_aviation.summary_en: General Dynamics announced on July 29, 2026 that its second‑quarter revenue reached $14.09 billion, with the Aerospace segment posting the fastest growth among its business lines, making it the primary driver of the quarter’s performance. The report shows that the aerospace segment's growth rate was the highest of all segments, and this contributed significantly to the overall revenue beat. The second‑quarter revenue figure of $14.09 billion was disclosed in the earnings release dated July 29, 2026.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士第二季交付237架飛機 並維持全年870架目標
international_aviation.summary: 據Simple Flying報導，空中巴士於2026年第二季共交付237架飛機。空中巴士同時維持全年交付870架飛機的目標。報導指出，維持永續的產能提升，對空中巴士達成全年870架交付目標將是關鍵要素。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus Delivers 237 Aircraft In Q2, Maintains Full-Year Target Of 870
international_aviation.summary_en: According to a report published by Simple Flying on July 29, 2026, Airbus achieved 237 aircraft deliveries during the second quarter. In addition to these delivery results, Airbus is keeping its target of 870 deliveries for the full year. Simple Flying reported that maintaining a sustainable production ramp-up will be crucial in order for Airbus to achieve its 870-aircraft delivery target for the full year.

international_aviation.headline: Allegiant Air將於特定客機推出頭等艙並提供免費飲料
international_aviation.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，航空公司 Allegiant Air 準備在特定客機上引進頭等艙服務，逐步超越過往的基礎飛行型態。全新的高級客艙將配備尺寸更大的座位，並向搭乘該客艙的乘客提供免費飲料服務，為旅客帶來更豐富的客艙體驗選擇。
international_aviation.headline_en: Allegiant Air To Introduce First Class Seating And Complimentary Drinks On Select Aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Allegiant Air is set to introduce a First Class cabin on select aircraft, marking a shift beyond its traditional bare-bones service model. According to details reported by Simple Flying, the airline's new premium cabin option will feature larger seats for passenger comfort as well as complimentary drinks during flights. The introduction of these upgraded seating choices represents an expansion of the carrier's passenger product offerings on designated aircraft within its fleet.
